title: Post Entry Pass Reads
description: A wing passer practises reading the post defender's position to choose between a direct bounce entry and a lob over the top.

content.objective: Choose the correct post-entry pass based on where the defender is playing.
content.setup: A wing passer faces a post player at the block, with a defender working for position behind or in front.
instructions: If the defender fronts the post, the wing passer lobs the ball over the top.
If the defender plays behind, the wing passer delivers a firm bounce pass to the low target hand.
The post player seals and presents a target before every catch.
Rotate the defender's starting position every four reps.
coachingPoints: Read the defender's position before deciding the pass type, not after.
Throw the lob with enough height to clear the front defender safely.
Deliver the bounce pass to the low hand target, not the chest.
commonMistakes: Throwing the same pass regardless of the defender's position.
Post player not presenting a target hand before the catch.
Passing from a standstill instead of stepping into it.
content.safety: Lob passes should be soft enough to control, not a hard overhead throw.
